petty crime: The police say that petty crime, such as shoplifting and bike theft, has risen near the night market.
警方表示，像是順手牽羊和偷腳踏車這類輕罪，在夜市附近有所增加。
petty cash: The office keeps a little petty cash in a drawer to pay for small things like coffee and stamps.
辦公室在抽屜裡放了一點零用金，用來支付咖啡和郵票這類小東西。
petty jealousy: Don't let petty jealousy ruin your friendship just because she got a slightly higher score than you.
別只因為她的分數比你高一點點，就讓小心眼的嫉妒毀了你們的友誼。
petty officials: The petty officials at the local office kept asking for more forms, so the simple process took weeks.
地方辦公室的小官僚一直要求更多表格，所以這個簡單的程序拖了好幾週。
petty arguments: My roommates often have petty arguments about who should take out the trash or wash the dishes.
我的室友們常為了誰該倒垃圾或洗碗而發生雞毛蒜皮的爭吵。
a petty-minded person: Only a petty-minded person would stay angry for weeks because a friend forgot to say thank you once.
只有小氣又心胸狹窄的人，才會因為朋友一次忘了道謝就氣上好幾個星期。
be philosophical about defeat: Instead of crying after the game, the coach told us to be philosophical about defeat and learn from our mistakes.
比賽後教練沒有讓我們哭泣，而是要我們對失敗泰然處之，並從錯誤中學習。
a philosophical question: "What makes a life truly meaningful?" is a philosophical question that people have discussed for thousands of years.
「什麼讓人生真正有意義？」是一個人們討論了數千年的哲學問題。
a philosophical attitude: Grandpa takes a philosophical attitude toward getting old and says every age has its own joys.
爺爺對變老抱持豁達的態度，他說每個年紀都有它自己的樂趣。
physical education: In physical education class today, we ran around the track and then played basketball in the gym.
今天的體育課上，我們先繞著跑道跑步，然後在體育館打籃球。
physical appearance: We should judge people by their character, not by their physical appearance, such as height or weight.
我們應該以品格來評斷一個人，而不是看身高或體重這些外貌。
physical contact: During the flu season, doctors advised people to avoid physical contact like hugging and shaking hands.
流感季節期間，醫生建議大家避免擁抱和握手之類的身體接觸。
a physical examination: All new employees must have a physical examination, including blood tests and an eye check, before they start work.
所有新進員工在開始上班前都必須做體檢，包括抽血檢查和視力檢查。
physical evidence: The detective found no physical evidence, such as fingerprints or footprints, to prove the man was at the scene.
警探沒有找到任何指紋或腳印之類的物證，能證明那名男子曾在現場。
physical labor: Working on a farm involves hours of physical labor, such as carrying heavy bags and digging in the fields.
在農場工作需要好幾個小時的體力勞動，像是搬重袋子和在田裡挖土。
a physical impossibility: Finishing a marathon in one hour is a physical impossibility, because no human can run that fast.
一小時跑完馬拉松是物理上不可能的事，因為沒有人能跑那麼快。
physical therapy: After her knee surgery, she needed months of physical therapy before she could walk without help again.
膝蓋手術後，她需要好幾個月的物理治療，才能再次不靠人扶走路。
plain English: The doctor explained my illness in plain English instead of using difficult medical words I couldn't understand.
醫生用簡明的英語解釋我的病情，而不是用我聽不懂的艱深醫學用語。
a plain fact: It is a plain fact that smoking harms your health; nobody can seriously argue against it.
抽菸有害健康是明顯的事實，沒有人能認真反駁這一點。
be plain to see: After the long drought, the damage to the crops was plain to see, even from the road.
經過長期乾旱，作物受到的損害一目了然，就連從路上都看得出來。
plain clothes: The police officers wore plain clothes instead of uniforms so the thieves would not recognize them.
警察穿著便服而不是制服，這樣小偷就認不出他們。
a plain girl: She was a plain girl who was not considered pretty, but her warm smile made everyone like her.
她是個長相普通、不被認為漂亮的女孩，但她溫暖的笑容讓每個人都喜歡她。
plain yogurt: I prefer plain yogurt with no sugar or flavor added, so I mix in fresh fruit myself.
我比較喜歡沒有加糖或調味的原味優格，所以我自己拌入新鮮水果。
make it plain that: The teacher made it plain that late homework would not be accepted under any circumstances.
老師明白表示，在任何情況下遲交的作業都不會被接受。
plain sailing: Once we found a good guide, the rest of the trip was plain sailing, with no more problems at all.
一旦我們找到好導遊，剩下的旅程就一帆風順，再也沒有任何問題。
in plain sight: I searched everywhere for my keys, and they were in plain sight on the kitchen table the whole time.
我到處找我的鑰匙，結果它們一直都在廚房桌上明顯可見的地方。
plain and simple: Copying someone else's essay and handing it in as your own is cheating, plain and simple.
抄別人的作文當作自己的交出去就是作弊，簡單明瞭。
plastic surgery: The actress had plastic surgery on her nose because she wanted to look different in her new movie.
那位女演員為了在新電影中看起來不一樣，去做了鼻子的整形手術。
a plastic bag: Many stores now charge for a plastic bag, so I always bring my own cloth bag to reduce waste.
現在很多商店的塑膠袋都要收費，所以我總是自備布袋來減少垃圾。
a plastic smile: The saleswoman wore a plastic smile that looked fake, as if she were only pretending to be happy.
那位女店員掛著虛假的笑容，看起來很做作，好像只是假裝很開心。
the plastic arts: Sculpture and pottery belong to the plastic arts, in which artists shape materials like clay into three-dimensional forms.
雕塑和陶藝屬於造形藝術，藝術家在其中把黏土等材料塑造成立體的形狀。
plastic money: Many young people rarely carry cash and depend on plastic money, such as credit cards, for most purchases.
很多年輕人很少帶現金，大部分購物都靠信用卡這類「塑膠貨幣」。
